name: Raid step 15: two solo runs of The Fractured Archive through its empty rooms, one by the west doors (Ezekiel, Moia, the Dagon'hai Elder) and one by the east (Bork, Dreadnoth, Xarth), each from the Archive Door through the Guardian's hall to Ocellus's room; the transporters and a Passageway back out.
